description: JASPER Asset Manager model portfolios for Benchmark Personalization. Each portfolio is a themed product built only from ETFs of a single issuer family (BlackRock iShares, Vanguard, State Street SPDR, Invesco) so the UI can truthfully show the AM badge. Holdings are live US-listed ETFs in the demo/Investment Pool — not cross-issuer mixes under a fake brand.

portfolios.name: Balanced Core
portfolios.description: BlackRock iShares balanced core: 60% US large-cap equity (IVV) and 40% US aggregate bonds (AGG). All constituents are iShares ETFs.

source.name: iShares — Core S&P 500 + Core U.S. Aggregate Bond
